description: This file defines the TbResultSet class, which implements the AsyncResultSet interface for handling Cassandra query result sets, including methods for fetching all rows asynchronously with size limits, pagination, and internal processing.

classes.name: TbResultSet
classes.description: Implements asynchronous handling of Cassandra query result sets with pagination, size limiting, and row aggregation.

methods.name: TbResultSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the result set with the original statement, delegate result set, and async execution function.

methods.name: getColumnDefinitions
methods.description: Returns column definitions of the result set.

methods.name: getExecutionInfo
methods.description: Returns execution info of the query.

methods.name: hasMorePages
methods.description: Checks if more pages are available.

methods.name: wasApplied
methods.description: Indicates if the last query was applied.

methods.name: allRows
methods.description: Returns a future with all rows, optionally limited by size.

methods.name: processRows
methods.description: Internal method to process and accumulate rows, handle pagination, and size limits.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Loads current page rows into a list.
